text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days had swiftly passed since coming to summer training camp with Hishi Akebono.
Before we knew it, the final day was upon us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After powering through all that grueling training with a smile, now was the time
to treat Hishi Akebono to a heartfelt, home-cooked feast!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Great work today, Trainer!
Summer camp has been so much fun, hasn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what should we do for dinner tonight?
The meals provided by the lodge are great, but maybe I could whip up—
choice_data_list: I just remembered something I have to take care of!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Wh-What's the rush all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Is it work? Do you want me to help out?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You've been working non-stop all throughout summer camp, Trainer.
Don't you think you should get some rest~?
choice_data_list: Don't worry, I'm full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ooh~. Ahaha, alright then, if you say so!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's a bummer we can't eat dinner together,
but there's always next time! See you later, Trainer~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, looks like I managed not to give it away.
There isn't much time, I have to hurry and get things ready.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First and foremost: ingredients. I decided to ask
some horsegirls if they knew any good shops nearby—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
A feast for Bono? Count us in!
She's always cooking for us, so we'd love to thank her!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: I know a great shop! They had tons of fresh fish!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
There's a greengrocer too. I'll go grab the veggies.
Can I leave the meat to you?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl D
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I bet a bunch of other girls want to thank her too,
so I'll go round them up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before long, our little group had multiplied,
and after two hours of dividing and conquering—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, WHOA~?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
What's with this huge spread?! Skewers, yakisoba,
whoa, even ajillo?! ...Wait, is that chanko nabe too?!
choice_data_list: We made all this for you, Hishi Akebono.
We made all this for you, Hishi Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh...? All this, for me?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Your Trainer wanted to thank you for everything,
so we decided to jump in and help out.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for always making us such delicious food!
We've been wanting to return the favor for ages.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
Whenever we eat your cooking,
it fills us with energy and gets us pumped for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl D
text_block_list.text:
You're always the one making us happy,
so we wanted to make you happy for a change...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...*sniff*, yeah! Right now, I'm super duper happy!
And completely starving! Can we dig in already?!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, of course!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Alright then... On three!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Itadakimasu~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A lively night on the beach, filled with mouthwatering aromas,
the cheerful laughter of horsegirls, and—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Buono! Everything over here and over there is so, so buono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone! Thank you, Trainer!
Delicious food really brings happiness, doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There she was, beaming with pure bliss.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After cleaning everything up and heading back to the lodge—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Phaaah☆ I'm so full!
Thank you so much for today!
choice_data_list: I hope it showed how grateful I am.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It totally did!
I was so, so very happy~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And you know what? I finally understand.
...The feelings that people put into eating!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
People say 'itadakimasu' before eating, right?
I bet that exact moment is when the final seasoning is added!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All those feelings of gratitude and joy coming together
are what truly complete the dish!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Just like how a hot pot needs lots of ingredients, it needs lots of feelings too.
That's what 'true chanko' must be~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I was always just thinking about
making things taste good...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I ignored the gratitude of the people eating it,
but I guess I never really paid enough attention to it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So from now on, I want to truly take in every 'itadakimasu,'
and make sure absolutely everyone feels satisfied from the bottom of their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Because I think that's how we finally reach
a true 'gochisosama' in the end~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
...Hey, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I used to think I just wanted to be a chanko-like horsegirl
who brings smiles to everyone's faces—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But on top of that, I want to be a horsegirl like 'true chanko'—
one that makes everyone want to see me smile too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Really? ...I see.
So that's how you feel about me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu.
Trainer, you're just like the dashi broth to me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yup! If I'm the chanko pot, you're the broth!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The absolute, most essential ingredient that I can't do without!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a quirky metaphor that could only come from Hishi Akebono,
but her beaming smile and words were overflowing with deep trust.
